steps.clueRiddle:
Climb the little mountain that named the city.
One last look before we race east.
steps.clueReveal: Check out by ten and grab the car. Drive up and park at Beaver Lake. Walk the flat path to the big lookout.

challenges.title: Spot from the Top
challenges.instructions: Stand at the railing and look far out. Find all five things in the view. Point at each one before you tap.

steps.funFact: Montréal is named after Mount Royal, the small mountain right in the middle.

steps.clueRiddle:
Point the car east and follow the big river.
A city with a wall around it is waiting.
steps.clueReveal: Drive from Montréal to Québec City. Play the car games on the way.

challenges.title: New France Trivia
challenges.instructions: Answer questions about Québec City. Guess before you tap. Streaks earn more points.

challenges.title: Autoroute 20 Bingo
challenges.instructions: Watch out the window. Stamp each thing you spot. Four in a row wins.

challenges.title: French Pack 2
challenges.instructions: Learn three new French phrases. Say each one out loud. Then take the quiz.

steps.funFact: Autoroute 20 follows the St. Lawrence River all the way east.

steps.clueRiddle:
Halfway there, three rivers meet one giant one.
Shake out your legs before you sit again.
steps.clueReveal: Stop at the riverfront in Trois-Rivières. Run around before lunch.

challenges.title: Riverside Wake-Up
challenges.instructions: Touch three different benches. Find the river and wave. Do twenty jumping jacks.

steps.funFact: Trois-Rivières means "three rivers." The city was founded in 1634.

steps.clueRiddle:
A little box climbs the cliff on a cable.
At the top, a castle wears a green roof.
steps.clueReveal: Ride the funicular up to Dufferin Terrace. Photograph the Château Frontenac.

challenges.title: Castle Shot
challenges.instructions: Ride the cliff railway to the top. Find the giant castle hotel. Take your best photo.

challenges.title: Tower Count
challenges.instructions: Look along the castle roof. Count every tower and pointy turret.

steps.funFact: This cliff railway has carried people up and down since 1879.

steps.location: Fêtes de la Nouvelle-France — City Hall Gardens
steps.clueRiddle:
Walk through the gate and lose three hundred years.
Everybody here forgot to change their clothes.
steps.clueReveal: Who can travel back in time? Walk to the City Hall gardens. Meet the costumed performers.

challenges.title: Time Traveler Hunt
challenges.instructions: The festival is full of people from long ago. Find all five. Tap each one you spot.

challenges.title: Greet a Time Traveler
challenges.instructions: Pick a costumed performer. Stand tall and smile. Say the phrase out loud.

steps.funFact: New France was the French colony here more than 400 years ago.

steps.clueRiddle:
Tonight's dinner is hiding on shelves down our own street.
Grab it fast — the clock is running.
steps.clueReveal: Go to Metro Plus on Rue du Marais. Find everything in fifteen minutes.

challenges.title: Supermarket Dash
challenges.instructions: Start the stopwatch at the door. Find every item on the list. Beat fifteen minutes!
checklist: A fruit you have never tried
A snack with a French-only label
Something cold from the dairy aisle
A treat for the whole team

steps.funFact: This supermarket is on the same street as tonight's hotel.

steps.clueRiddle:
The mat is waiting at the end of Rue du Marais.
Run — every second still counts.
steps.clueReveal: Check in at Hôtel Le Dauphin. Step onto the pit stop mat.
steps.funFact: The mall next door hides a huge indoor amusement park.
